asr_model.description: Accepted for existing Workflow compatibility and ignored. External ASR is selected only by RuntimeProfile ptt_asr_model or realtime_asr_model.

speaker_voices.description: Map speaker names to Voice aliases. Names must be nonblank and contain neither 【 nor 】. Recognized streaming markers are stripped from device text.

unknown_speaker_policy.description: Opt-in default_voice reserves paragraph-leading short 【name】 markers for speakers: unknown names of 1-32 Unicode code points are stripped and use the output route Voice (node_voices, then default_voice). Known names retain speaker_voices. Names permit letters, numbers, combining marks, symbols, quotation marks, spaces, hyphen, underscore, period, middle dot and ZWJ; blank, nested, malformed, overlong and inline bracket text remains literal. Requires default_voice and does not support conversation.continue_from.
